We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 UI/UX Designer (m/f/d) Your role

You own how fonio feels on the web. Our website is our most important storefront - and right now it's not where it needs to be. You don't build one nice page, you build a system: a design system and landing page templates that roll out into localized pages across 9+ markets. Continuous optimization, not a one-off redesign. You design and ship - you own the build end-to-end, not a handoff to engineering. We're building an AI operating system for SMBs - people should feel that on the website.

What to expect

 * You own the design and continuous optimization of our website and landing pages

 * You build a scalable design system with reusable components

 * You develop landing page templates that localize across all markets (DACH, FR, IT, ES, UK, PL, US, and more)

 * You design and ship live yourself - full ownership from concept to published page

 * You think in user journey, conversion, and responsive design

 * You work closely with the Creative Director on brand direction

Who we're looking for

 * Several years of experience as a UI/UX or web designer focused on converting websites (portfolio required)

 * You think in systems and components, not individual pages

 * You build and ship yourself

 * Experience with design systems and localization across multiple markets

 * You understand conversion and think in journeys

 * German + good English

What we offer

 * Competitive salary: €65,000-€90,000

 * Equity - you're building this, so you should own a piece of it.

 * Food & drinks - lunch and dinner are on us at the Vienna office (plus all the drinks you want, and yes, we have protein bars and vitamins too).

 * Relocation bonus (if you still need to move to Vienna)

 * Equipment of your choice - whatever makes you happy.

 * Regular team offsites.

Hiring process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview

 * 20 min culture fit with the founders

1 Principal AI Engineer Your Tasks
 * Being part of SQUER means driving solutions in client projects and actively shaping SQUER with your knowledge.
 * Lead our clients in their AI adoption, develop their AI vision and target picture, and translate both into a concrete, prioritised transformation roadmap.
 * You will support several teams by solving complex challenges of both frontend and backend development.
 * You will be responsible for introducing or improving the AI-usage in the SDLC across the engineering teams of our clients and successfully deliver software solutions together.
 * You can communicate openly and are a team player.
 * You are actively involved in all phases of software development in an interdisciplinary manner and are happy to share your knowledge with your colleagues as a sparring partner and coach.
 * You are an active member of mostly agile SCRUM teams and spread SQUER culture with the aim of constant improvement.

Your Qualifications
 * Your experience and big-picture-thinking allows you to create solutions that generate a sustainable impact for our clients. 
 * You are a rolemodel in the usage of AI-powered tools (e.g., code assistants, LLM-based workflows) to amplify your productivity and quality and you are proficient in guiding teams in their AI adoption.
 * You have several years of experience within software architecture, cloud-native development and containerization (Docker or Kubernetes). You would like to deepen your knowledge in this field.
 * You have solid knowledge of frontend and backend development and relevant trends within this area excite you.
 * You have a hands-on mentality and are proficient in one or more programming languages in the Java ( Java, Kotlin, Scala, Clojure, ...), Javascript (Javascript, Typescript) or cloud-native environment (Rust, Go, ...).
 * You continuously improve the AI-adoption along the entire SDLC, resolve bottlenecks and feel passionate about enabling software teams in all their disciplines.
 * Trainings and development of your skills are highly important to you. Moreover, you enjoy passing on acquired knowledge.
 * You are fluent in English and German (written and spoken) in order to communicate in the best way possible with colleagues and partners.

Your Benefits

 * Learn & Grow: Tap into a € 5.000 annual training budget to sharpen your skills and take advantage of our in-house Leadership Academy. Join and be part of our active tech community through meetups, hackathons and training sessions. Get up to 40h/year additional time off for your personal education.
 * Flexibility for Performance: Benefit from hybrid work options, flexible hours, workations within the EU, and additional vacation days - giving you the freedom to perform at your best.
 * Tailored Tools for Success: Choose your preferred hardware configuration to suit your working style.
 * We Value You: Beyond perks and benefits, we offer a competitive annual salary to recognize your exceptional contributions.
 * Be Part of a Thriving Team Culture: At SQUER, collaboration and connection are at the heart of what we do. Through open communication, shared successes, and meaningful team events - including our annual SQUER offsite - we cultivate a culture where everyone feels valued and inspired to grow together.
 * A Perks-Packed Workplace: Work in a central office with a spacious terrace and BBQ, enjoy free lunch in the office, MyClubs sports membership, and either a free "Wiener Linien" ticket or a partial contribution to the "Klimaticket". Plus, benefit from free massages, referral bonuses, Corporate Benefits, and JobRad. Annual employee presents and a monthly team breakfast add extra value to your work experience.

 
We believe in transparent and fair compensation. For this role, the annual gross salary ranges between € 95.000 and € 105.000 - the exact placement depends on the seniority level we assess together during the process.

jobs.description:
1 Junior Scientists (f/m/d) for 6G Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC) - JOB ID: 269373  * You will develop and validate numerical signal processing algorithms for mobile 5G/6G ISAC scenarios using simulations and measurements from an SDR testbed combining RF, fiber optic, and quantum sensing.
 * Depending on your background, you will conduct algorithm research and contribute to real-time experiments using SDR hardware and reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS).

 * Together with experienced colleagues, you will engage in establishing a unique 6G distributed MIMO sensing testbed based on SDR technology using open-source tools such as GNU Radio, RFNoC and LabVIEW for real-time FPGA algorithm design operating from 0.4 - 20 GHz.

 * You will learn how to evaluate the results and prepare them for further studies.
 * You will publish your research results in international journals and present them at conferences.
 * You will accumulate experience in a research field, that has an enormous range of applications from construction, logistics, aviation and railways to agriculture, robotics and defense.
 * You will gain experience in a group of international scientists and build up your professional network within European wide research projects.

Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner:

 * Completed technical studies (at least MSc.) related to Telecommunications, Computer Science or Electrical Engineering
 * First experience in at least one of the following areas: (i) multi-static MIMO UAV sensing, (ii) quantum sensing with NV centers and Rydberg cells, (iii) multimodal sensing with fiber optic and distributed RF sensors, or (iv) ISAC using reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS) and two-way ranging. Candidates should indicate in their cover letter how their background and interests align with one of these profiles (i-iv) and provide evidence of relevant expertise. Applications not addressing this point may not be considered.
 * Hands-on experience in radio frequency (RF) lab experimentation and printed circuit board design for the profiles listed above.
 * Excellent knowledge in the field of signal processing, RF propagation modeling, AI/ML and numerical simulation software development (MATLAB or Python)
 * Sound knowledge of electromagnetic field simulation tools, antenna design, and real-time FPGA programming.
 * Interest in reading and writing scientific publications and enjoyment of solving application-oriented questions from industry
 * High level of commitment and ability to work in a team
 * German and English skills commensurate with the role

 

What to expect: 

 * The minimum gross annual salary on a full-time basis (38,5 h / week) according to the collective agreement is EUR 56.784,--. The actual salary will be determined individually, based on your qualifications and experience.
 * Our employee benefits include meal allowances, healthcare benefits, pension support, family benefits, additional days off, vouchers, sports and cultural activities, and flexible working models including up to 50% home office.We also support conference participation, networking, and individual training and career development opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Master Thesis "Characterizing features of Driving Dynamics on a Motorcycle Probe Vehicle" - JOB ID: 269966
jobs.description:
As Austria's largest research and technology organisation for applied research, we are dedicated to make substantial contributions to solving the major challenges of our time, climate change and digitalisation. To achieve our goals, we rely on our specific research, development and technology competencies, which are the basis of our commitment to excellence in all areas. With our open culture of innovation and our motivated, international teams, we are working to position AIT as Austria's leading research institution at the highest international level and to make a positive contribution to the economy and society.

The Center for Innovation Systems & Policy is looking for new Ingenious Partners for our location in Vienna. Our Center for Innovation Systems & Policy is a think tank in national and international research and innovation networks, and it is a key partner for public administration, companies, universities, and research institutions.

The Com... 1 Master Thesis "Characterizing features of Driving Dynamics on a Motorcycle Probe Vehicle" - JOB ID: 269966  * For this master's thesis you will investigate extensive time series of driving dynamics obtained from multiple motorcycle rides by multiple riders on given tracks.
 * You will support us in working out characteristic features in driving dynamics that differentiate the different riders.
 * You will investigate the possibility of using simulation software (like IPG Motorcycle maker) to use the obtained data for setting up simulations of motorcycle movements.

 * Under the guidance of our researchers, you will implement model building approaches to extract characterizing features from motorcyclist data.
 * With the support of our team, you will investigate the feasibility of simulating driver movements based on the characterizing features extracted before.
 * You will explore different model-building approaches and criteria for selecting the most appropriate one with the guidance of our researchers.

Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner:

 * Ongoing master's studies in the field of Technical Mathematics at TU Vienna
 * Good knowledge in R, Python, or MATLAB, willingness to adopt multiple of these languages as needed
 * Enjoyment of application-oriented questions of industry
 * High level of commitment and team spirit
 * English or German skills commensurate with the role - The thesis can be completed in either language

 

What to expect:

 * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months
 * Start date: as soon as possible, with some flexibility depending on your availability
 * EUR 1273 gross per month for 20 hours/week based on the collective agreement.
 * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results.
 * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).

 

 

At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.

 

Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates (transcript of records), as well as a proof of identity.
